_comment: Platform-wide public figures. Context only: they are not merchant precedents and are never used to compute a merchant's predicted effect.

facts.statement: Transaction losses were approximately $1.3 billion in 2025 and $1.1 billion in 2024, an increase of $223 million or 20%.

Transaction, loan, and consumer receivable losses were $1,337.2 million in 2025, $794.2 million in 2024 and $660.7 million in 2023. Transaction losses include chargebacks for unauthorised card use and disputes over delivery of goods or services.
facts.caveat: Combines transaction, loan and consumer receivable losses; not a dispute-loss figure on its own.

facts.statement: The order's monitoring provisions use a monthly chargeback rate above 0.75% as a trigger. Exact obligation: read the order; we only saw an excerpt.
